messages:
Nora (CS): Quick heads up — Hestia pilot next Tue. They need a short CS-facing quickstart: prefill, streaming UX, debounce, cache hygiene, and renewal escalation. Drafting checklist here.
Caleb (SRE): Ops constraints: demo traffic spikes; prefer preserving latency under 600ms p50 but cap cost. Recommend warmpool + strict per-session caps.
Ivy (AE): Finance asked for automatic alerts at 125% of forecast. Renewal play if avg cost/session > target for 5 days.
Rohan (DevEx): UX recs: streaming with interim tokens; require explicit /commit call before saving. Client debounce 300ms. Provide sample snippet for finalize handshake.
Nora (CS): Customer Quickstart (single page):
- Share 12 canonical prompts (we will prefill via /prefill API). Keep templates <220 tokens.
- Warmup: reserve 1 GPU for 72h; run 40 scripted sessions pre-launch.
- Streaming: enable chunked streaming; render partials; call /commit on accept.
- Debounce: client should debounce edits to 250-350ms and coalesce identical rapid edits.
- Cache keys: use stable key = hexsha(tenant|template|norm_prefix). TTL=8h; don't include volatile IDs.
- Cost caps: per-session token cap=12k; daily acct cap=$375 -> AE notif at 125%.
- Fallbacks: model switch to quantized variant when util>70% or p95>900ms sustained 3m; halve batch size on fallback.
- Telemetry: emit token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit, route_tag, and action_type.
- Escalation: oncall SRE, EngOps lead, AE (contacts in Confluence).
Caleb (SRE): Ops snippet for EngOps rules:
```json
{"tenant":"hestia","warm_pool_gpus":1,"cache_ttl_s":28800,"per_session_token_cap":12000,"daily_cost_cap_usd":375,"fallback": {"util_pct":70,"p95_ms":900}}
```
Ivy (AE): I'll attach the billing thresholds to the AE dashboard and prep the renewal playbook (7-day signal -> outreach).
runbook-bot: Published quickstart: /cs-runbooks/hestia-quickstart-prefill-and-guards - https://confluence.internal/hestia-quickstart
Nora (CS): Thanks — I'll circulate the customer PDF and tag this thread for handoff.
